shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && ls -R .agents | head -100 && ls -la && cat package.json AGENTS.md 2>/dev/null; git ls-files

for f in src/* index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore; do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done; ls __agent_eval__; head -60 .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; echo ======; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md

npm view @gravity-ui/uikit peerDependenciesMeta && npm install @gravity-ui/uikit 2>&1 | tail -5 && node -p "require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json').version" && .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit TextInput PasswordInput Checkbox Button Card Text Flex ThemeProvider Provider
bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit TextInput PasswordInput Checkbox Button Card Text Flex ThemeProvider Provider 2>&1 | head -80; git diff package.json

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && wc -l build/docs/INDEX.md README.md && cat build/docs/INDEX.md | head -120; echo ====; rg -n -i -C 6 "required setup|styles.css|Provider" README.md | head -120

wc -l components/controls/TextInput.md components/controls/PasswordInput.md components/Checkbox.md components/Button.md components/Card.md guides/theming.md guides/layout.md; echo; rg -n "^\| *\`?(label|type|value|onUpdate|onChange|errorMessage|validationState|autoComplete|name|placeholder|size|id|controlProps|hasClear|autoFocus|disabled|note)\b" components/controls/TextInput.md | head -40; echo ---PW; rg -n "^\|" components/controls/PasswordInput.md | head -40

sed -n 1,22p components/controls/PasswordInput.md; echo ---CB; rg -n "^\|" components/Checkbox.md; echo ---BTN; rg -n "^\| *(type|loading|width|size|view|disabled|onClick)\b" components/Button.md; echo ---CARD; rg -n "^\||<Card" components/Card.md | head -30; echo ---TEXT; rg -n "^\| *(as|variant|color)\b|as=" components/Text.md | head; echo ---PROV; rg -n -C 3 "<Provider|import \{.*Provider" guides/theming.md | head -50

sed -n 180,200p components/Button.md; rg -n -C2 "size" components/Card.md | head -30; echo ---LAYOUT; rg -n "^\| *(direction|gap|alignItems|justifyContent|spacing|width)\b|<Flex[^>]*>" guides/layout.md | head -20; echo ---I18N; rg -n -C3 "configure|lang" guides/i18n.md | head -40

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && ls build; f=$(ls build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts build/*/components/Text/Text.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -1); echo $f; cat $f | head -60; d=$(dirname $(dirname $f)); cat $d/Card/Card.d.ts | head -50; ls $d/layout;

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/cjs/components/layout && cat Flex/Flex.d.ts | head -60; rg -n "padding\b|padding\?|maxWidth|width\?|as\?|SpacingValue|type Spacing" Box/Box.d.ts types.d.ts | head -30
rm -rf dist && sed -i 's/<html lang="en">/<html lang="ru">/' index.html && git status --short
